# Research Papers: full agent brief

Academic research library with a 488,491-record operator corpus, a 478,991-record public analytics snapshot, selected public indexes, citation analytics, reading paths, and a cited-answer demo.

## Index

# researchPapers

The operator corpus retains 488,491 papers from arXiv, OpenReview, bioRxiv, and medRxiv for concrete technical and market questions. The deployed public analytics snapshot contains 478,991 records.

## What it is

- Operator-maintained ClickHouse corpus with 488,491 records
- Deployed public analytics snapshot with 478,991 records
- Selected public indexes with citation, reviewer, topic, and graph signals
- Curated reading paths with source notes
- Public cited-answer route protected by Turnstile

The complete semantic index is an operator-side capability. Public browser search uses selected static exports.

## Agent entrypoints

- https://papers.highsignal.app/llms.txt
- https://papers.highsignal.app/api/ai
- https://papers.highsignal.app/index.md

Do not invent paper claims. Keep citations attached to corpus results.
